title: A Asset for the Ghost
author: R. M. Eastwick
blurb: Cyrus Brightwater, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, works cases no one wants attributed. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
